opportunity.action_idea: When a termination or book-move list arrives, a script looks up every live deal for the listed counterparties or deal numbers and produces the move file for the target book, plus a before-and-after check. The book admin reviews exceptions and runs the move; credit still decides which counterparties are terminated.
opportunity.description: Risk, credit or middle office send lists of deals or terminated counterparties to move or flip between trading books, including bankruptcy books, and the book admin moves them and confirms before books are calculated.
